display_long_description:
Step into the future of movement.
Kynetik is a sci-fi hand-tracking wave shooter that transforms your body into a weapon of energy and speed. Using nothing but your hands, unleash powerful blasts, deflect enemy fire, and crush waves of rogue robots in fast, rhythm-like combat arenas.

Designed for fun, fitness, and flow, Kynetik keeps you on your toes with evolving challenges and dynamic environments that react to your every move. Every punch, dodge, and blast strengthens your reflexes and stamina — no controllers, no limits.

Whether you’re looking for a quick energy burst or an intense full-body session, Kynetik delivers instant action, glowing visuals, and pure motion satisfaction.

Features:

⚡ Hand-Tracked Combat: Feel the thrill of shooting, blocking, and dodging using only your hands.

🤖 Wave-Based Action: Face waves of robots that get faster, smarter, and more intense.

🏋️‍♂️ Fitness Through Fun: Burn calories while fighting in fluid, high-energy sessions.

🌌 Futuristic Arenas: Immerse yourself in glowing sci-fi worlds powered by motion and light.

🎯 Easy to Play, Hard to Master: Perfect for both casual and competitive players.
